_comment: Manually-curated 'other' projects shown in the Featured Projects section. Plugin entries are derived from the plugin marketplace at build time and rendered into the PROJECTS-PLUGINS sentinel. Append objects to `other` to add non-plugin projects (web apps, sites, tools).

other.name: ccmcp
other.description: Dynamic CLI and TUI (Go) for managing Claude Code's MCP servers, plugins, and per-project overrides. One view across user config, local state, committed .mcp.json, plugin manifests, and OAuth integrations — bulk-toggle by scope or filter.

other.name: robworks-claude-code-plugins
other.description: The Claude Code plugin marketplace catalog that powers this site's /plugins/ page. A single marketplace.json manifest pointing at three external plugin repos.
